observed_bottleneck: Parent n-5e9392f126c0 uniformly sampled all eligible token blocks even though its seed-0 proposal logs show that 335,178 of 365,802 latent points (91.63%) inverse-decoded to the unchanged anchor, only 24,721 points (6.76%) entered a unique valid acquisition pool, and 66 of 145 rounds reached the 4,096-attempt guard. The waste was most severe on median_2, where 99,697 of 104,863 points were unchanged, unique-pool yield was 4.09%, only 7 of 127 recorded anchor transitions improved their source anchor, and terminal Top-1 rose by just 0.02328; the method therefore needs to direct the same bounded perturbations toward token blocks that actually influence the decoded molecule.
hypothesis: Replace uniform token-block choice with Token-level Adaptive Candidate Sampling: estimate which eligible SeqFlow blocks most strongly control each evaluated anchor's inverse-decoded token sequence, then preferentially perturb those high-importance blocks while preserving bounded nonzero sampling support for every eligible block. This should spend more of the fixed proposal work on structurally effective local coordinates and expose a more distinct de novo pool to the unchanged Thompson selector.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.
